title: Baritone USAGE.md — goto, thisway and stop/cancel commands
content_excerpt: Baritone usage: 'thisway 1000' then 'path' walks in the direction you are facing for a thousand blocks; 'goto x y z', 'goto x z' or 'goto y' goes to a coordinate in a single step and starts going immediately; 'cancel' or 'stop' stops everything, and 'forcecancel' is also an option; 'goto portal' or 'goto ender_chest' or 'goto block_type' goes to a block.
evidence_notes: 命令层把“停止”与“到达”明确分开（stop/cancel/forcecancel 不产生到达语义），支持本项目中“中断不等于成功”的契约设计；也说明长途目标按单步执行而非一次到位。
related_game_versions: Baritone 支持的 Java Edition 版本
notes: Baritone 是 Java 模组，本项目通过协议层复现其行为语义，不直接调用其命令。
